answers.m5: Marco uses a shared Google Calendar for the class roster, but it doesn't stop two people from claiming the same slot if they both edit it around the same time.

answers.m7: Jordan runs one-on-one training sessions only, no group classes. Double-booking never happens to him because every slot has exactly one client.
